name: Salorino (Spain)
description: White field with a blue horizontal stripe in the lower part, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Salorino (a tree on yellow and a cross of Alcántara above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Salorino; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Salorino arms — tree and cross of Alcántara above waves
